_comment: Per-agent write-scope allowlist, enforced by the PreToolUse hook in src/cli.ts. An agent NOT listed here is unrestricted — listing it is what opts it in. Patterns: absolute, or ~/ for home; a trailing /** means this directory and everything under it; anything else is an exact file match. Keep this in sync with each charter's memory_writes: the charter is the claim, this file is the enforcement, and they drift silently if you only edit one.
